name: Simtable
description: Commercial augmented reality sand table combining physical terrain models with digital agent-based simulation overlays for incident command training and planning. Used by fire departments, military, emergency managers, and urban planners. Enables real-time visualization of fire spread, flood dynamics, and evacuation routes on physical terrain.
domain: incident command, emergency management, military planning
difficulty_level: variable (used at all levels from local fire to national exercises)
reputation: established commercial platform; used by US Forest Service, military branches, and emergency management agencies
notes: Commercial hardware/software platform. Physical sand table with projector overlay creates intuitive spatial interface for incident command exercises. Integrates real terrain data and live weather.
